left_out: Level 3 admits training-time numerical routines such as preconditioners, but the battery-fastcharge-ageing-development-v1 contract registers no capabilities at this level; difference_from_ladder lists it among empty_levels.

Battery surrogate networks (kNN, MLP, DeepONet, FNO) are small — widths up to 512, depths up to 6, at most 61 Fourier modes — and fit in memory, so standard first-order optimisation (Adam family at level 2 via optimizer.optimizer_family) and optional L-BFGS polish (level 2 via stages.polish_steps) already cover the numerical routines the training needs; no separate preconditioner or second-order solver capability is justified.

No candidate-side governing PDE equation is registered for the DFN battery model — objective.pde_weight is research_only with the note 'no candidate-side governing equation is registered for the DFN model' — so physics-informed preconditioning, residual-based adaptive sampling, or PDE-residual numerical routines have no residual to operate on at this level.

stages.physics_warmup_steps, the only training-stage numerical ramp considered for the Challenge, is research_only at level 2 because 'it ramps a PDE residual battery does not have'; this removes the main candidate for a level-3 numerical routine.

The optimiser-adjacent literature cards (arxiv-2501.16371v6 for SSBFGS/SSBroyden, arxiv-2602.16167v1 for SpecMuon) concern optimiser-family extensions that would belong to level 2's optimizer.optimizer_family, not to level-3 training-time numerical routines such as preconditioners, and the contract owner has not registered them as capabilities.
